lines.t: Church lights bright, but the doctrine dark They preach hellfire, but they miss his heart
Sleepin' in the dust till the trumpet spark Resurrection on the way, watch the dead depart
They not gone forever, they just sleep up in the grave When the lines start to roll, every sleeper get raised
No eternal torture, that's a lie the serpent made
Either life inside the sun, or you vanish in the flame
They told your grandma lookin' down, but the book say she a risk
No more pain, no passin' time, no stress in her chest
She don't mean to grave, not a dungeon for a soul
Just dust in the ground till the king take role
Break up at the guard, but the mind shut down
Silence in the dirt, no voice, no sound
Did no nothin', just a blink till it calls
When the sky crack open and the last trump falls
They not gone forever, they just sleep up in the grave
When the lions start to roar, every sleeper gettin' raised
No eternal torture, that's a lot of serpent made
Either life inside the sun, or you vanish in the flame
I'm a thug with a scroll, I'm a problem on the mic
Steppin' in the church with that resurrection hype
Modern Pharisees get rich off it
Sellin' tickets into hell that don't even appear
You call my savior a tormentor?
Homie, that's fraud
You just painted Satan, mask on God
He slept in the tomb, three nights on chill
Didn't tour no torture pit, just obeyed the Father's will
With the wages of sin, it's death why you say we can't die
You repeatin' that serpent, same Genesis lie
You preach wicked, live forever, just scorched in the heat
But the sentence say perish, that's existence, delete
They not gone forever, they just sleep up in the grave
When the lights start to roar, every sleeper gettin' raised
No eternal torture, that's a lie the serpent made
Either life inside the sun, or vanish in the flame
Yo, church of men with your stained glass pride You chain the flock up with a dragon at your side
Doctrine of hell, put blood on your hands You smear his mercy while you threaten the land
He said those who push that lie don't know him at all
You blasphemed his name when you slandered his call
He take no pleasure when the wicked pass away You weaponize his word just to make the people pay
It's life or death, there ain't no third lane Eternal life and Messiah or you fade like rain
Second death, then the fire, then the wicked, no more
Just ashes in the dust while the righteous soar
They not gone forever, they just sleep up in the grave
When the lions start to roar, every sleeper getting raised
No eternal torture, that's a lie the servant made
Either life inside the sun or you vanish in the flame
So don't cry like I'm with no hope in that chest
It's a blink between the last breath and the rest
First food rolls up, more bodies by the rise
When the dead and Messiah meet the king in the skies
I'm a thug for the truth, let the whole hood see
Even when we dyin', I'ma just sleep, breathe, free
